mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l WHERE l.data_set_id=#{id} AND l.deleted=0 AND l.layer_status='READY' AND l.geographic_extent && ST_MakeEnvelope(#{b[0]},#{b[1]},#{b[2]},#{b[3]},4326) ORDER BY l.id
SELECT set_config('statement_timeout', CAST(#{milliseconds} AS text), true) || set_config('jit','off',true) || set_config('plan_cache_mode','force_custom_plan',true)

SELECT s.data_set_id,s.schema_version,s.data_revision,s.template_checksum FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_dataset_style s JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id=s.data_set_id AND ds.deleted=0 AND ds.category_id=2 WHERE s.data_set_id=#{dataSetId}

WITH eligible_layers AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT l.id,l.geometry_type,l.assignment_mode,g.id AS group_id,g.group_key,p.value AS rule FROM jsonb_array_elements(CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->'groups') p(value) JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_group g ON g.data_set_id=#{dataSetId} AND g.group_key=p.value->>'groupKey' JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l ON l.data_set_id=g.data_set_id AND l.group_id=g.id AND l.deleted=0 AND l.layer_status='READY' WHERE CASE WHEN #{z} = (CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->>'nativeMaxZoom')::integer THEN (CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->>'displayMaxZoom')::double precision ELSE #{z} + log(2.0, (CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->>'tileSize')::numeric / 256) END >= (p.value->>'minZoom')::double precision ), shapes AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT f.id,f.layer_id,l.group_id,l.group_key,l.geometry_type, (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(a.key,a.value),'{}'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_each(f.properties) a WHERE jsonb_typeof(a.value) IN ('string','number','boolean') AND jsonb_exists(CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->'propertyFields',a.key)) AS properties, (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(a.key),'[]'::jsonb)::text FROM jsonb_each(f.properties) a WHERE a.value='null'::jsonb AND jsonb_exists(CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->'propertyFields',a.key)) AS null_fields, CASE WHEN COALESCE((l.rule->>'preserveBoundary')::boolean,false) OR l.geometry_type='POINT' OR #{z}=18 THEN f.display_geom WHEN l.geometry_type='LINE' THEN ST_Simplify(f.display_geom, 40075016.68557849/(power(2.0,#{z})*512)*(CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->>'simplifyPixels')::double precision) ELSE ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(f.display_geom, 40075016.68557849/(power(2.0,#{z})*512)*(CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->>'simplifyPixels')::double precision) END AS shape, CASE WHEN l.geometry_type='POLYGON' THEN ST_PointOnSurface(f.display_geom) END AS anchor FROM eligible_layers l JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature f ON f.layer_id=l.id AND f.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.value FROM jsonb_array_elements(l.rule->'overrides') WITH ORDINALITY r(value,seq) WHERE jsonb_array_length(l.rule->'overrides')>0 AND l.assignment_mode='AUTO' AND ocean_gis.vector_filter_matches(f.properties,r.value->'filter',true) ORDER BY seq LIMIT 1 ) r ON true WHERE CASE WHEN #{z} = (CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->>'nativeMaxZoom')::integer THEN (CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->>'displayMaxZoom')::double precision ELSE #{z} + log(2.0, (CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->>'tileSize')::numeric / 256) END >= COALESCE((r.value->>'minZoom')::double precision,(l.rule->>'minZoom')::double precision) AND f.display_geom && ST_TileEnvelope(#{z},#{x},#{y},margin => 256.0/8192) -- 小视窗先排除仅包围盒相交的大面；保留简化容差及量化余量，避免漏掉瓦片边缘。 -- 世界和洲级视窗命中范围广，继续直接使用空间索引筛选。 AND (#{z} < 4 OR ST_Intersects(f.display_geom, ST_TileEnvelope(#{z},#{x},#{y},margin => 257.0/8192 + (CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->>'simplifyPixels')::double precision/512))) AND (COALESCE((l.rule->>'preserveBoundary')::boolean,false) OR #{z}=18 OR CASE l.geometry_type WHEN 'POLYGON' THEN ST_Area(f.display_geom)/power(40075016.68557849/(power(2.0,#{z})*512),2) >= (CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->>'polygonMinAreaPixels')::double precision WHEN 'LINE' THEN ST_Length(f.display_geom)/(40075016.68557849/(power(2.0,#{z})*512)) >= (CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb)->>'lineMinLengthPixels')::double precision ELSE true END) ), representations AS ( SELECT id,layer_id,properties,null_fields,group_id,group_key, CASE geometry_type WHEN 'POLYGON' THEN 'FILL' ELSE 'GEOMETRY' END AS role, geometry_type AS category,shape AS display_geom FROM shapes UNION ALL -- 从真实面提取边界，再做瓦片裁剪，避免产生裁切边缘线。 SELECT id,layer_id,properties,null_fields,group_id,group_key,'OUTLINE','LINE',ST_Boundary(shape) FROM shapes WHERE geometry_type='POLYGON' UNION ALL SELECT id,layer_id,properties,null_fields,group_id,group_key,'LABEL','POINT',anchor FROM shapes WHERE geometry_type='POLYGON' AND ST_X(anchor)>=ST_XMin(ST_TileEnvelope(#{z},#{x},#{y})) AND ST_X(anchor)<ST_XMax(ST_TileEnvelope(#{z},#{x},#{y})) AND ST_Y(anchor)>ST_YMin(ST_TileEnvelope(#{z},#{x},#{y})) AND ST_Y(anchor)<=ST_YMax(ST_TileEnvelope(#{z},#{x},#{y})) ), encoded AS ( SELECT o.id::text || ':' || o.role AS "_vector_representation_id", o.id::text AS "_vector_feature_id",o.layer_id::text AS "_vector_layer_id", o.group_id::text AS "_vector_group_id",o.group_key AS "_vector_group_key", o.role AS "_vector_render_role",o.category AS "_vector_category", o.properties,o.null_fields AS "_vector_null_fields",g.geom FROM representations o CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ST_AsMVTGeom(o.display_geom,ST_TileEnvelope(#{z},#{x},#{y}),8192,256,true) AS geom OFFSET 0 ) g WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(g.geom) AND ST_Dimension(g.geom)=CASE o.category WHEN 'POINT' THEN 0 WHEN 'LINE' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ), tile AS ( SELECT COALESCE(ST_AsMVT(encoded,'features',8192,'geom' ORDER BY "_vector_representation_id"),''::bytea) AS body FROM encoded ) SELECT CASE WHEN octet_length(body)<=#{maxBytes} THEN body END AS body,octet_length(body)::bigint AS byte_size FROM tile
